reason: Three original Chrome prefix cells reach exact transformed text and native InputModeUS but retain KDERU. Passive D-Bus proves a completed US switch; existing IBus Wayland wire contains an old-RU modifier echo. Exact host-version KWin5.24.7 external setLayout forwards seat modifiers but leaves its existing input-method keyboard grab pending until another physical key. Its input-method echo handler can silently overwrite XKB group.
decision: Test an upstream-scoped compatibility fix in KWin KeyboardLayoutDBusInterface::setLayout: after a valid XKB switch, immediately publish pending modifiers to the existing InputMethod grab through forwardModifiers(NoForce), when InputMethod exists. Preserve existing physical-key forwarding order. Build privately on the remote host before native qualification; do not install or replace the system compositor.
